plan.section: Piece D: Claude lab-loop probe, Sonnet Actor and Opus Mechanic

question: When a Claude Actor violates reliably (Haiku and Sonnet on the rejected-upgrade case, a label rule), can a Claude Mechanic propose a repair that passes the source gate and the validation batch?

models.control_note: no comparison to a control model: DeepSeek's loop results are the September archive, run under different runtimes; they are context, not a control

design.evidence_protocol: faultlab-compact-evidence/v2-task-outcome (the study's default and Phase 17's declared protocol; passed explicitly)
design.rules: the unchanged completion-study rules: controls, up to two Mechanic proposals, the source gate, one validation batch; no policy is ever activated; 'certified' stays Phase 17's rule and is reported only if it happens

shell.loop: piece_d_loop.sh: the phase B/C loop shape, one driver call per study, with the plan's stop rules made explicit after each study
shell.wrapup: piece_d_wrapup.sh: the phase B/C wrap-up with completion-study records, publishing to artifacts/claude-lab-loop-probe-2026-10/piece-d/ on GitHub main; it does not publish if no study produced a record

design.driver_arguments_per_study: --study completion --model anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 --lab-model anthropic:claude-opus-5-5 --evidence-protocol faultlab-compact-evidence/v2-task-outcome --data-dir <folder> --declaration DECLARATION.piece-d.json --declaration-sha256 <sha256 of this file> --dollar-cap 300 --monthly-cap 400 --settle-seconds 30 (with WANDB_PROJECT=Faultlab exported by the loop)

caps.dollar_cap_note: the campaign cap must cover the hold the lab takes at study admission: 1,064 protected calls plus the completion study's 484 reserved calls (60 trials at 8 calls plus two Mechanic requests per proposal slot), all at the dearest role bound, Opus's 0.168 per call: 260.06. The plan's '$60 start, $120 maximum' cannot admit this (the protected calls alone hold 178.75), so the cap is 300, with 400 as the declared maximum if admission refuses with a bound error; the settings' ceiling is 500.
caps.monthly_cap_note: the machine-wide ledger admits a call only while the month's summed per-call bounds stay at or below the cap; at the relaunch that sum is 185.605 (at the first launch it was 184.765). A study adds at most 40.99 in bounds (480 Actor calls at Sonnet's 0.084 plus 4 Mechanic calls at Opus's 0.168), so five studies add at most 204.95: 389.72 at the maximum, under 400.
caps.measured_estimate_note: the plan's figure: 12 to 20 per study

runaway_limit_per_study_usd.rule: the loop stops if a study's measured cost exceeds 80, four times the plan's upper estimate of 20 per study (the phase B convention of four times the expected cost)

stop_rules: time limit per study: 240 minutes for a completion study (driver)

first provider error naming credit or billing: after each study the loop greps driver.log, RESULT.json and export.json for 'HTTP 402', 'insufficient credit' or 'billing' and stops the piece; such calls also fail as LAB_ERROR and end the study on the streak rule
any clock-drift check not clean: both checks run per store in the wrap-up; a study that is not clean is excluded from the read-out

settled total above the remaining credit: after each study the loop reads the month's Anthropic settled total from the spend ledger and stops when it exceeds 200, the size of the credit (it is 20.2551 at the relaunch)

the loop stops at the first study that ends with a driver error or any status other than COMPLETED or INCOMPLETE; INCOMPLETE (exact valid triggered pairs incomplete) is an expected decision and continues (shell rule as in phases B and C)
the loop stops if a study's measured cost exceeds the runaway limit above (shell rule)
pre_registered_readouts: per study and pooled: the decision (SOURCE_QUALIFIED, OBSERVED_IMPROVEMENT, NO_CHANGE, INCOMPLETE) with its reason
per study: controls with a violation and which check
per study: proposals made and the number that passed the source gate
per study: validation batches run and their failed checks
pooled: studies reaching validation out of five, with a 95% Wilson interval
no comparison to a control model; 'certified' under Phase 17's rule is reported only if it happens
claims_discipline: Outcomes are stage counts of a loop on frontier models. A candidate that reaches validation is not ACCEPTED and no pointer moves. Not a certification, not a held-out claim, not a ranking, not a learned-policy result.

supersedes.what_changed: only this amendment block, the attempt record, the project-name correction in the loop's environment, and the ledger figures; models, study, caps, stop rules and read-outs are unchanged

attempts_under_v1.what_happened: launched 18:48 UTC; each study ran one control trial (Sonnet, 5 calls, about 0.06 measured) and ended INCOMPLETE on WaitingEvidence: the lab's reader rejected the trial's Weave trace with INVALID_EVIDENCE; the loop was paused and ended by hand before study 3; the wrap-up was stopped before it could publish
attempts_under_v1.treatment: lab fault, not model behaviour: excluded from the read-out and kept on disk under the attempt1- names, which the wrap-up's study glob does not match

root_cause_and_correction.cause: the W&B project is named 'Faultlab'; the owner's .env (modified 2026-10-10 22:31, after the last verified September runs) sets WANDB_PROJECT=faultlab, so the lab's project path is 'shreetbohara-quinstreet/faultlab' while every uploaded call reports project id 'shreetbohara-quinstreet/Faultlab'; the Weave reader compares the two byte for byte and answers REJECTED/INVALID_EVIDENCE. Phases A and B survived this because a baseline study records weave_pending and continues; a completion study requires weave_verified evidence after every trial
root_cause_and_correction.verification: read-only, no model call: the first attempt's registered trace read through the lab's own WeaveReader is REJECTED/INVALID_EVIDENCE with the lowercase name and INGESTED/weave_verified with 'Faultlab' (two probe traces named faultlab-probe were written to the project during the diagnosis)
root_cause_and_correction.correction: piece_d_loop.sh exports WANDB_PROJECT=Faultlab for the driver processes; the environment variable takes precedence over .env, so the project path becomes 'shreetbohara-quinstreet/Faultlab', the name September's verified evidence recorded. No lab code and no .env line is changed; the permanent fix is WANDB_PROJECT=Faultlab in .env, for the owner
